entities.name: UAC-0050
entities.gloss: A threat group linked to Russian law enforcement structures, known for credential harvesting and access brokerage.

entities.name: DaVinci Group
entities.gloss: A cyber threat group identity formerly used by the threat actor UAC-0050.

entities.name: REMCOS RAT
entities.gloss: A commercial remote access Trojan often abused by threat actors for surveillance and system control.

entities.name: QUASAR RAT
entities.gloss: An open-source remote access Trojan for Windows operating systems commonly used in malicious campaigns.

entities.name: VENOM RAT
entities.gloss: A remote access Trojan derived from Quasar RAT that provides remote control capabilities.

entities.name: REMOTE UTILITIES
entities.gloss: A legitimate remote desktop access software tool frequently abused by threat actors for unauthorized access.

entities.name: LUMMASTEALER
entities.gloss: An information-stealing Trojan that targets credentials, cryptocurrency wallets, and browser data.

entities.name: UAC-0010
entities.gloss: A Russian state-sponsored cyber espionage group also known as Gamaredon or Armageddon.

entities.name: Sandworm
entities.gloss: A Russian advanced persistent threat group associated with the GRU and known for destructive attacks.
